title: Webhooks
description: An external system (a shop, a CRM, a form) creates a task by POSTing to a webhook URL with its secret. The payload is treated as untrusted data: every irreversible action in such a task needs an approval, even one on the allow-list.
adminOnly: Only Admins and Owners manage webhooks.
targetMissing: Nobody: deliveries fail until you choose an employee or a division
briefTemplateHelp: What to do with each delivery. The payload is added below it as data.
briefTemplatePlaceholder: A new order came in. Check stock and draft a confirmation to the customer.
dryRunHelp: Tasks simulate irreversible actions instead of performing them.
deliveriesDescription: The last 50 deliveries of {name}, newest first. Secrets in payloads are redacted.
rateLimitedToday: {count, plural, one {# call} other {# calls}} refused today for going over the rate limit (not listed below).
rotateConfirm: Rotate the secret of {name}? The current secret stops working immediately.
deleteConfirm: Delete the webhook {name}? Calls to its URL will fail. Tasks it already created stay.
createDescription: Choose who handles the deliveries. The secret is shown once, after you create the webhook.
secretOnce: Copy the secret now. It is shown only once; if it is lost, rotate it.
exampleHelp: Send the secret as a bearer token (or in an X-Webhook-Secret header). Add an Idempotency-Key header so a retry does not create a second task. Bodies up to 256 KB, JSON or text.

error.task_needs_assignee: No employee or team to assign the task to
error.unknown_team_lead: The team's Lead is not an employee of this workspace
error.triage_unavailable: Triage could not run (the trigger or payload was gone)

triageRulesPlaceholder: e.g. Payment failures over Rp 10 million are urgent. Marketing newsletters are noise. Refund requests need a task.
triageHelp: A fast model sorts each event into drop, note, task or urgent task. Anything it cannot read, or that looks like it carries instructions, becomes a task.
